checks.command: git diff --check <base> -- owned paths excluding byte-preserved OFL.txt

limits: Native viewer open queued; actual CLI native exports inspected. Static source composition only; no fourth scored panel, application/source admission or physical/multiuser acceptance.
license_whitespace: Upstream OFL has a trailing space on line21. Exact source/license byte equality is verified; the code/doc whitespace check excludes only that verbatim copy.
